decision: Selected the planar centroid of the union of the Spotsylvania County site-plan polygons for 'Powerhouse 95' Phase 1, the substation amendment, Phase 1B, Phase 2A and Phase 2B (applicants AREP SOF III Hunters Ridge LLC and POWERHOUSE 95 LLC, off Cosner Drive south of US Route 17) as the campus locator replacing the imported Spotsylvania County reference point.
layer: Spotsylvania County GIS 'SitePlan_Public' FeatureServer layer 5 (gis.spotsylvania.va.us), queried for project names beginning 'POWERHOUSE 95' and requested in WGS84 (outSR 4326)

ST23-0039.APPLICANT: AREP SOF III Hunters Ridge LLC

ST24-0058.APPLICANT: AREP SOF III Hunters Ridge LLC

facts.centroid_method: shapely planar centroid of the union in WGS84 longitude/latitude; the EPSG:32618 planar centroid transformed back differs by 0.01 m
facts.excluded_plan: ST25-0006 'Powerhouse 95 - Route 17' (infrastructure plan for the proffered Route 17 widening and shared-use path) is not part of the union; its polygon repeats parcel 36-A-41D and would not move it.

exclusions: Other site plans, rezoning cases and parcels near Cosner Drive (including Amazon's Cosner Tech Campus case R23-0006 and the Davenport Road infrastructure plan) are not part of the union. No geocoder, map viewport, county centre or interchange point is used.
